description: List the covered cities and metro areas with the number of venues in each, grouped by country. It does not list courts: to find courts, call search_courts with city=<a name from this list>. Pass 'country' (e.g. 'Spain') to list one country; 'detail'=true adds per-city counts by sport (larger answer). The counts are mapped venues, not a quality measure.

country.description: Only this country, name or ISO code, e.g. 'Spain' or 'ES'.

detail.description: Per-city counts by sport and hidden-private counts (much larger answer).

name: list_coverage
title: List coverage
